svg.aria-label: Tech stack of Dhruvil Dhamecha displayed as a Daredevil weapon rack
svg.title: Tech Stack: The Devil's Arsenal
svg.desc: Daredevil-themed tech stack. A Daredevil mask on a stand above two batons, and six baton racks holding languages, web, backend and data, cyber security, developer tools, and cloud, AI and creative tools.

g.text: Sharpened in silence. Deployed without fear.
Built to hunt bugs, not to be found.
Tools of the Man Without Fear
Software engineer. Coder. Computer geek. Cyber security vigilante.
What the city gets to see
